```plato

    // Restricts each component of self to [0, 1] using the vector's own Zero and
    // One elements (the component-wise analogue of CoreAlgebra's Saturate).
    Saturate(self: IVector): IVector
        => self.Max(self.Zero).Min(self.One);
```
